title: Lore of Lockheed and Northrop crash retrievals without oversight

tellings.quote: the UFO front, you have all this lore of like the Lockheeds and Northreps engaging in crash retrievalss and not having proper supervision or oversight when it comes to the government.

plain: There is a lot of lore, Michels says, that aerospace companies like Lockheed and Northrop have recovered crashed UFOs without proper supervision or oversight from the government. He offers this himself as background in an episode with a former head of the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, and names no source. If true, private companies would hold such material out of the public's and the government's reach.
